title: Taiwan Australian National University Scholarship
about: ANU scholarship for citizens of Taiwan undertaking full-time PhD study at ANU, starting between May and August 2027. Up to five awards of $39,069 per annum plus full tuition are expected; applications close 30 November 2026.
requirements: Must be admitted to and continuing full-time PhD study at ANU
Study must begin between 1 May 2027 and 31 August 2027
Applicants must also apply to Taiwan's Department of International and Cross-Strait Education (window 9 Nov 2026 to 25 Nov 2026, midday)
Selection based on consistently high academic results

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Must be admitted to and continuing full-time PhD study at ANU" (field: "Doctoral research (any ANU discipline)") → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Selection based on consistently high academic results" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
